unit.why: A short anecdote, heard from the Maggid, about how he once reacted on seeing an immodest woman while he was a village teacher.
unit.boundary_note: Trailing heading 'מענין מחלוקת' belongs to the next division.

stories.summary_en: When the Maggid was a village teacher, he glanced by accident at a nobleman's immodestly dressed companion. Distressed, he made himself loathe evil by thinking on the repulsive origins of her beauty, until he vomited before them and the nobleman had him thrown out.
